machine.opis: Wentylator promieniowy, napęd bezpośredni, łożysko po stronie wirnika

state.units: envelope spectrum amplitudes in gE; acceleration in g; frequencies in Hz
state.technician_notes: Temperatura obudowy łożyska 58 °C, stabilna. Ostatnie smarowanie 2 tygodnie temu.

fault_location.instructions: Use the matched envelope-spectrum peaks in `envelope_peak_matches` (harmonics of the bearing defect frequencies and their sidebands), `unmatched_envelope_peaks`, the indicators in `time_domain_indicators` and `technician_notes`. Which rolling bearing defect best explains the envelope spectrum?

criteria.outer_race: Series of BPFO harmonics, typically without 1x sidebands (stationary outer ring).
criteria.inner_race: BPFI harmonics modulated by 1x sidebands (rotating inner ring passes the load zone).
criteria.cage: FTF and its harmonics, possibly modulating other defect frequencies.
criteria.none: No bearing defect frequencies are present; the spectrum is not explained by a bearing defect.

damage_stage.instructions: Use the matched envelope-spectrum peaks in `envelope_peak_matches` (harmonics of the bearing defect frequencies and their sidebands), `unmatched_envelope_peaks`, the indicators in `time_domain_indicators` and `technician_notes`. What stage of rolling bearing damage does the evidence indicate?
criteria: Stage 0 – healthy: no defect frequencies, low envelope level, kurtosis near 3.
Stage 1 – incipient: ultrasonic / high-frequency activity only, defect frequencies barely visible.
Stage 2 – developing: clear defect frequency with a few harmonics in the envelope, rising trend.
Stage 3 – advanced: many harmonics and sidebands, high envelope level, defect frequencies may appear in velocity spectrum.
Stage 4 – near failure: broadband noise floor rise, harmonics smear, 1x rises; failure imminent.

lubrication_problem.instructions: Use the matched envelope-spectrum peaks in `envelope_peak_matches` (harmonics of the bearing defect frequencies and their sidebands), `unmatched_envelope_peaks`, the indicators in `time_domain_indicators` and `technician_notes`. Is a lubrication problem (insufficient or degraded grease) a more likely explanation than a localized defect? Lubrication issues raise broadband high-frequency levels without discrete defect-frequency harmonics.

action.instructions: Use the matched envelope-spectrum peaks in `envelope_peak_matches` (harmonics of the bearing defect frequencies and their sidebands), `unmatched_envelope_peaks`, the indicators in `time_domain_indicators` and `technician_notes`. What maintenance action is most appropriate now?

criteria.continue_monitoring: No defect or only incipient signs; keep the normal measurement interval.
criteria.shorten_interval: Developing defect; shorten the measurement interval and plan replacement.
criteria.plan_replacement: Clear, progressing defect; schedule bearing replacement at the next planned stop.
criteria.replace_urgently: Advanced damage or near failure; replace as soon as possible.
